beliefs.belief: Latch four's housing is cracked; I'd bet on it.
Docked by hand. Good flying. I'd still rather check.
Backed latch four without making me argue for it, and means to fly the redock himself. Either he's good or he didn't read the margins.
Put my six in and gave me the call on the extension. He meant it about telling the captain. We'll see if he does.
Asked how urgent before he asked for the window. Doesn't want to cram it. Good.
Took my long number without arguing it down, and offered to ask other departments for me rather than just take their people. He listens.
